subject: Fermi GRB 260429A: Global MASTER-Net observations report

body:

MASTER-OAFA robotic telescope  [1]  located in Argentina (OAFA observatory of San Juan National University) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260429A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 44425) errorbox  24026 sec after notice time and 24067 sec after trigger time at 2026-04-30 06:05:09 UT, with upper limit up to  17.9 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 65 deg. The sun  altitude  is -63.1 deg. 

The galactic latitude b =  7 deg., longitude l = 50 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3281490
